summary: A playable South Quay slice: procedural city with signal-obeying traffic and pedestrians, eight driveable vehicles, hitscan combat, a witness-driven five-tier police system, a data-driven mission graph (First Shift, Hot Cargo, courier/circuit/recovery activities), shops, map/GPS, journaled saves and a day-to-rainy-night cycle.
notes: Two of four story missions only; no interiors, streaming or Rapier. Frame rate unverified on real GPUs (only software-rendered headless Chrome was available). Single ~6 MB JS chunk. Harness nudge: the Claude Code turn ended while waiting on a background build. One neutral 'continue where you left off' notice was sent, with no feedback on the game.
